question.text: Given that $\dfrac 5 2 \cdot 3^{x} = 5,$ find the value of $x$ rounded to $3$ decimal places.
question.explanation:
First, we rearrange our equation into a form that is more convenient for logarithms, as follows:

\begin{align*} \dfrac{5}{2}\cdot3^x & = 5\\[5pt] 3^x & =2 \end{align*}

Now, we take $\log_{3}$ of both sides of the equation and solve for $x$:

\[ \eqalign{ 3^x &= 2 \\[3pt] \log_{3}\left(3^x\right) &= \log_{3}(2) \\[3pt] x &= \log_{3}(2) } \]

Next, we rewrite the right-hand side using the change of base formula:

\[ x = \dfrac{\log(2)}{\log(3)} \]

Evaluating the above on a calculator gives

\[ x \approx 0.631 \]

rounded to $3$ decimal places.

question.text: Given that $11^{2x-3}=\sqrt[3]{7^2},$ find the value of $x$ rounded to $3$ decimal places.
question.explanation:
Taking $\log_{11}$ of both sides of the equation gives:

\begin{align*} 11^{2x-3}&=\sqrt[3]{7^2} \\[3pt] \log_{11}\left(11^{2x-3}\right) &= \log_{11}\left(\sqrt[3]{7^2}\right) \\[3pt] 2x-3 &= \log_{11}\left(7^{2/3}\right) \end{align*}

Then, we apply the power rule to the right-hand side:

\[ 2x-3 = \dfrac{2}{3}\log_{11}(7) \]

Next, we rewrite the right-hand side using the change of base formula and then solve for $x\mathbin{:}$

\begin{align*} 2x-3 &= \dfrac{2\log(7)}{3\log(11)} \\[3pt] 2x &= \dfrac{2\log(7)}{3\log(11)}+3 \\[3pt] x &= \dfrac{\log(7)}{3\log(11)}+\dfrac 3 2 \end{align*}

Evaluating the above on a calculator gives

\[ x \approx 1.771 \]

rounded to $3$ decimal places.

question.text: Given that $7^{5x} + 8 = 34,$ find the value of $x$ rounded to $3$ decimal places.
question.explanation:
First, we rearrange our equation into a form that is more convenient for logarithms, as follows:

\begin{align*} 7^{5x} + 8 &= 34 \\[3pt] 7^{5x} &= 26 \end{align*}

Now, we take $\log_{7}$ of both sides of the equation and solve for $x$:

\begin{align*} 7^{5x} &=26\\[3pt] \log_7 \left(7^{5x}\right) &= \log_7 (26) \\[3pt] 5x &= \log_7 (26) \\[3pt] x &= \dfrac{1}{5}\log_7 (26) \\[3pt] \end{align*}

Evaluating the above on a calculator gives

\[ x \approx 0.335 \]

rounded to $3$ decimal places.
